source: QZ issue attachments; physical Android HCI captures of one Tacx Neo 2
client: qdomyos-zwift (QZ), attributed by the submitter; not confirmed from the capture itself
evidenceTier: upstream hardware-observed evidence on one unit of unknown firmware; not FitBridge tier H
why: Plan section 11 wants observed timing in a hardware evidence record and Phase 9 has none
archived for the Neo 2. It also records the single most consequential structural fact about
these captures, which is an absence - see subscriptions.

subscriptions.note: The client wrote 363 FE-C CONTROL frames without ever subscribing to the FE-C notify characteristic, so it issued commands it could not observe the response to, and read its telemetry from the standard CPS/CSC services instead. Consequence for this corpus: it contains NO FE-C telemetry frames. It is the exact complement of fec_tacx_neo_2.json, which contains FE-C telemetry and no control.

readRequests.note: Zero ATT Read Requests across both sessions. Every readable value on the device - DIS strings, CP Feature, CSC Feature, Sensor Location - is therefore unobserved. This is what blocks a Neo 2 simulator identity.

privacy: Link parameters, subscription structure and session-relative timing only. No addresses, device name, absolute timestamps or payloads.
